question: What is the meaning of documentation on collection during the end-of-life of a product in relation to life-cycle data?
data_point: documentation on collection during the end-of-life of a product
description: Documentation on collection during the end-of-life of a product in relation to life-cycle data refers to the information that includes sorting, collecting, and treating objects as they reach the end of their useful life. This documentation provides insights into the expected volume of waste at any given time and the potential for recycling resources. By understanding how products are collected and treated at the end of their life cycle, businesses can assess the environmental and social impact of the product throughout its entire life cycle, from production to disposal.
